items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Take like, this fellow played Dixieland, how do you call them? Sharky Banan and they played Dixieland

ctx.x: Yeah, not in the old band.

You know what I mean? How you can tell them old Dixieland drummers, I mean, and trumpet players, it's not like this now. In other words, everything is fast now, you understand what I mean? Take like, this fellow played Dixieland, how do you call them? Sharky Banan and they played Dixieland, you understand what I mean? They're like old times, do you understand what I mean? See, a long time ago it was more slow, you know what I mean? Because you couldn't get that, in other words the trumpet players and things were…

Can you tell us who your favorite drummers are, or were in the old days? Did you get, I guess you were busy most of the time and didn't get to hear many of the other bands. Which ones did you like when you heard them?
